assumptions: RMD motor masses and rated torque from user table, hardware revision/thermal conditions unverified. Link/tool/payload masses remain assumptions unless measured by user. Any other segments are preserved. Horizontal pitch-chain screening only.

tool_changer.note: Tool-change locking motor. The 0.300 kg ee actuator_mass_kg below is the retained motor-plus-bracket assembly mass, not motor mass alone. MX-106T continuous torque is unverified; 8.4 Nm is stall torque.

segments.name: wrist_yaw
segments.motor_spec_note: Independent wrist-yaw MX-106T #1. It is a yaw axis, so this planar horizontal pitch-chain screen includes only its mass/length as downstream load; yaw inertial torque, external docking moment, backlash, and bracket mass require a separate 3D calculation.

segments.name: ee
segments.motor_spec_note: Independent end-effector gripper-pinion MX-106T #2. Its pinion axis drives the gripper and ballpoint-style lock/unlock mechanism; it is not an arm pose joint. Fixed design point: 0.160 m, 0.400 kg total (0.300 kg motor-plus-bracket assembly plus 0.100 kg structure). Motor alone is 0.153 kg. Assembly mass needs measurement.

base_motor_reference.note: User assumption: stall times 0.5, NOT manufacturer rated torque. Metadata only; base yaw sizing is not implemented.
